From West End Girl · Price: your stand can only attack from a gap between two objects, and it's defenseless on open surfaces.

Theme Space

  • 1: Your stand can attack from any gap within its range (a door crack, between barrels) as if it were adjacent. Strikes from a gap gain +1 circumstance to damage per die.
  • 5: Strikes from a gap make the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard}.
  • 9: Surge: crush a creature next to a gap for @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 13: Crushing also immobilizes on a failure.
  • 17: You can attack from two gaps per turn.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
